title: Chapter 1005
text:
Because of the Flickering World, countless organizations had gathered in the Shattered Star Ring, and this Star Field was currently the most lively area in the entire universe, receiving the attention of everyone. Once there was a commotion, it would spread to every corner of the universe at the fastest speed.

Tolaen's challenge was not kept a secret, and the information of this battle spread rapidly through the quantum network. In just a few hours, the entire Shattered Star Ring exploded!

The birth of every Beyond Grade A was a major event in the universe. After Black Star, the Shattered Star Ring finally welcomed its sixth Beyond Grade A Super!

The news came too suddenly, and no organization was prepared. Everyone was urgently collecting information on Hella's past to understand this new Beyond Grade A Super who had suddenly appeared.

Before this, Hella did not have many records of her activities in the universe because she had been cultivating for a long time, so she did not receive much attention. Her most representative identity was the captain of Black Star's Guards, but in the past twenty years, she had disappeared without a trace. Now, she had silently stepped into the Beyond Grade A realm, and the first time she appeared, she had already displayed her strength to the entire universe, creating a convincing battle record!

Tolaen, who had joined the Arcane Church for many years, was not a weakling. He had taken the initiative to challenge Hella, but he had lost to her and instead made her famous. This kind of thing where one shot oneself in the foot was always something that people liked to hear.

A new Beyond Grade A Super defeating another new Beyond Grade A showed that her combat strength was very impressive at this level. Furthermore, according to the investigation, although Hella's promotion speed could not catch up to Han Xiao's record, it was still far faster than the average promotion time for a Beyond Grade A Super. This meant that she still had potential, and her achievements would not stop there.

The Shattered Star Ring was located in a remote area, and it had always been at the bottom of the Beyond Grade As in the various Star Fields. This situation had changed after Black Star appeared, and Hella's promotion had once again raised the status of the Shattered Star Ring.

However, compared to the birth of a new Beyond Grade A Super, what the various organizations were more concerned about was Hella's identity.

This new Beyond Grade A Super of the Shattered Star Ring was definitely not simple!

According to the information, not only was she a member of the Black Star Corps, but she was also Ames's student. At the same time, she had a relationship with two big shots and was also from the Blue Star Corps, just like Black Star.

When they saw Hella's birthplace, almost all the forces were shocked.

Blue Star, a small place that was still a civilization on the surface a few decades ago, actually produced two Beyond Grade As all of a sudden?

Just what was so special about this planet? How could it have such an outstanding place?!

He must have run into some dog shit luck!

Even with the addition of historical figures, these two were still … the only pair of fellow Beyond Grade As in the entire universe!

These special identities were the main reason why the various organizations were shocked. At this moment, what everyone was most concerned about was the impact the birth of this new Beyond Grade A Super would have on the current situation.

Since Hella's current identity was still that of an officer of the Black Star Corps, all the organizations knew that the Black Star Corps was most likely going to face a change. Hella might become independent, but what would Black Star do?

With this thought in mind, everyone was waiting to see how things would develop.

…

Bloodshed Land, Planet Heber.

"What? That Hella has stepped into the Beyond Grade A Super?"

Chief Vanguard Official Wrothers suddenly turned around and stared at Joad, who had come to report the news, with a stunned expression.

"Yes, just yesterday, she defeated Tolaen of the Arcane Church. The news is true."

Joad smiled bitterly.

This had happened too suddenly. When he first received the news, he was also shocked and only recovered after a long time.

"How could this be …"

Wrothers mumbled to himself with a face full of disbelief.

Decades ago, the two of them had represented the Bloodshed Land and fought against the Black Star Corps, but they were stopped before a victor was decided. He had always regarded Hella as his opponent, but he did not expect that he would once again be left far behind by the opponent he had always regarded in his heart.

At first, it was Black Star, and now it was Hella. Wrothers could not help but wonder … could it be that the Black Star Corps really had some special Beyond Grade A promotion technique?

The threshold of Beyond Grade A was still very far away for him, but his old opponent had already crossed it. The feeling of being surpassed did not feel good, and Wrothers felt a sense of helplessness.

At the same time, in the Tyrant's palace, Heber was also discussing this topic with Sorokin's consciousness.

"An important officer of the Black Star Corps has advanced to Beyond Grade A, and the biggest possibility is that they have an additional ally. This will cause the Black Star's forces and influence in the Shattered Star Ring to expand again, which is not good for us." Sorokin had a helpless expression. This sudden situation was not within his expectations, and there was nothing he could do about it.

"Someone related to Black Star again."

Heber was a little unhappy, and his heart was filled with jealousy.

Why is Black Star's luck so good that he can always recruit talents?

I'm also a Beyond Grade A, so why don't I have such powerful officers under my command?

"I don't have enough information on hand. If we want to contain Hella, we need to spend some time looking for her weakness. I'll get my subordinates to do this." Sorokin shrugged. "Before that, let's wait and see."

"Humph, up to you." Heber did not comment.

…

In the Shattered Star Ring, on the mother planet of the Star Pupil Protoss …

"Another one?"

Looking at the news about Hila on his communicator, Psyker gritted his teeth, and all seven of his eyes were hurting from anger.

After the Planet Lighthouse incident, his race's situation in the Shattered Star Ring was not good to begin with. Now, Black Star had another local Beyond Grade A friend.

Black Star worked for the dynasty and stood on the opposite side of him. Although Heber was not Black Star's friend, their positions were also on the opposite side. Other than that, the other three Beyond Grade As in the Shattered Star Ring were more or less related to Black Star. Not a single local Beyond Grade A stood on his side. His enemies in the local area had increased from four to five.

WDNMD！

How can I even stay in this broken place?

Sisko's mind exploded.

…

In this environment, Hella set off from Floating Dragon Island alone and headed toward the Black Star Corps headquarters.

This time, Ames did not go with her. She was forcefully dragged by Jenny to stay on Floating Dragon Island and had to deal with the backlog of matters.

Blue Star was very close to the Black Star Corps headquarters. Hella arrived at the headquarters that she had not seen for a long time. Han Xiao, who had returned from the Flickering World some time ago, was already waiting for her at the headquarters.

As soon as she entered the army, Hella felt that something was different.

Everyone in the Black Star Corps already knew that she had become a Beyond Grade A Super. Along the way, everyone looked at her with respect and curiosity.

She did not look around and first went to find Aurora, whom she had not seen for many years. She went straight to the officers' activity room, where many officers were already waiting.

"Congratulations on becoming a Beyond Grade A Super."

As soon as Hella entered the room, everyone welcomed her with smiles and congratulated her.

"Thank you." Hella nodded and responded to them one by one. Although she was cold, she was not unreasonable.

The atmosphere in the room was harmonious. At this time, a voice full of energy suddenly sounded, suppressing everyone's voice.

"Captain, you're finally back! I missed you so much! "

Hardaway walked out from the crowd and appeared in front of Hella. He had a fawning expression on his face, and his voice was extremely loud.

"You missed me?" Hella had a suspicious look on her face. She did not remember her relationship with Hardaway being so good.

"It's not just me. In the past twenty years, all the Black Star Guards have missed you. Without your leadership, we're not used to it! You must be tired after walking for so long. Don't just stand there, sit down and rest. Don't tire yourself out. "Hadavy's attitude was unbelievably warm, and he looked just like a dog licking his lips.

Everyone was shocked by his performance and looked over.

We remember that this was not what you said in the past …

The face-changing of the Sichuan Opera was too realistic!

Fu Ding raised his brows and reminded him playfully, "Is that so? Why do I remember you saying that Hella is incompetent and that when she returns, you'll challenge her for the position of captain. Now that she's back, your chance is here."

"Nonsense! I've never said such a thing! " Hardaway said with a righteous expression. "Hella, don't listen to these people. They're trying to drive a wedge between us. When I mention you in private, when have I not praised you? Don't believe these people who are jealous of our relationship! "

When he learned that Hella was a Beyond Grade A Super, he was shocked and wanted to slap himself in the face. He wanted to take back all the words he had said to Hella over the years.

She's already a Beyond Grade A Super, and I still want to challenge her position? Do you think I'm stupid?

What? You're saying I'm a coward?

Bullsh * t!

How can smart people be called cowardly? This is called judging the situation!

Everyone was shocked. He lied without even blinking. His skin is really thick!

"Is that so? Why don't I believe it? "Hella snorted.

Just as they were chatting, Aurora walked into the room and called out in surprise.

"Sister, you're back!"

Hella turned to look at Aurora, and her eyes instantly softened. She quickly walked in front of Aurora, sized up her sister whom she had not seen for many years, and asked a series of trivial questions that had accumulated in her heart.

"How have you been these years? Have you been eating well? Have you been sleeping well? "

Although she knew that Han Xiao would take care of Aurora, after the Germinal Organization was destroyed, she had not been separated from Aurora for so long. Every day, she could not help but worry about Aurora.

The two sisters chatted for a while before Hella reluctantly separated from Aurora. She knew that Han Xiao was still waiting for her in the office.

She walked all the way to the Army Commander's office. Hella pushed the door open and saw Han Xiao, whom she had not seen in a long time. He was sitting behind the desk, smiling at her.

"You're here." Han Xiao smiled and nodded. "Congratulations on entering the Beyond Grade A Super."

"I fulfilled my promise and came back after reaching the Beyond Grade A Super." Hella nodded and sat down in front of Han Xiao.

"I knew you could definitely do it. I never doubted it." Han Xiao sized up Hella. She had become more and more perfect in all aspects.

"I also knew that you would believe me."

The two of them looked at each other and smiled.

"I'm very happy to listen to your experiences over the years, but we'll talk about this later. Let's talk about business first." Han Xiao tapped his finger on the table, stared into Hella's eyes, and slowly said, "You're now a Beyond Grade A Super. Tell me, what are your plans for the future? Do you want to be independent? "

"If I choose to be independent, will you support me?" Hella asked.

"We're friends. I won't force you to work for me. If you choose to be independent, I'll do my best to support you, provide you with all the resources you need, and help you develop your own Beyond Grade A organization. "Han Xiao tapped the table and smiled.

Hearing this, Hella did not answer immediately. A rare look of hesitation appeared on her face.

The room fell into silence.

—

(I had some urgent matters today, so I didn't write much.)
